content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

Section 8 of the MSA meets the RENEWAL rule's **preferred** position on all material terms:

| Element | Preferred position | Document (§ 8.2–8.3) |
|---|---|---|
| Renewal term | 12 months | Successive twelve-month periods ✓ |
| Customer opt-out | 30 days' notice | At least thirty days' written notice ✓ |
| Vendor reminder | 60 days before renewal | At least sixty days beforehand ✓ |
| Price uplift | Lesser of CPI and 3% | Lesser of US CPI-U and three percent ✓ |

Two points that are actually better than our preferred baseline: § 8.2 extends Customer's opt-out deadline to thirty days after a late reminder is received (so a missed Vendor reminder cannot trap us in a renewal), and § 8.3 requires ninety days' notice of any increase and bars increases on prepaid periods.

I also confirmed there is no competing renewal or escalation language elsewhere — § 7.1 fixes Fees during the initial term and prohibits undisclosed charges, and § 4 (Order Forms) adds no renewal mechanics. Nothing here falls near the walk-away edge (no >90-day notice window, no multi-year auto-renewal).
